svg.title: Haloform reaction part B: cleavage to carboxylate and iodoform with curved arrows

g.text: Haloform (iodoform) reaction, part B: cleavage of the C–CI₃ bond
Step 3: hydroxide adds to the (now very electrophilic) carbonyl carbon
Step 4: C=O re-forms and the CI₃− ion leaves (stabilised by three iodine atoms)
Step 5: fast acid–base reaction – the carbanion takes the proton from the carboxylic acid
Net: CH₃COCH₃ + 3 I₂ + 4 NaOH → CHI₃↓ + CH₃COONa + 3 NaI + 3 H₂O
